calls.title: Demo Call with Pawel Goralczyk from GOG.com
calls.summary: The discussion centered around GOG's evaluation of Growth Book to meet their evolving A/B testing requirements. The team highlighted Growth Book's integrated platform that combines feature flags, experiments, and analytics in one package, improving management and consistency. With local SDK evaluation, GOG can minimize costs associated with high telemetry traffic from their current use of PostHog. Growth Book's warehouse-native design enhances data trust by keeping all experiment data in BigQuery, which directly addresses issues with redundancy and confidence in data integrity. The platform also features a visual editor that empowers non-technical users to create tests without engineering support. Pricing starts at $50,000 annually with a clear model that avoids costs based on traffic volume, making it easier for GOG to compare with current expenses.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, A/B Testing, Feature Flags, Self-Hosted, Data Warehouse, PostHog
